examples.title: Store revenue vs target
examples.description: A denser bullet: twelve stores compared against an annual revenue target ($K). Stores at or above target read in the meets-target colour, those below in the below-target colour, and the muted grey bands behind each bar mark quarters of that store’s own target so partial progress is easy to gauge.
